set.body: Observed during real-data native visual validation on qualified eyes4s bbb9d49a (headless Monocle, JavaFX 24, Java 25, 1440x900). Two presentation defects: (1) native TrialView in a 680x370 panel clips the map legend text after fades below 10% of m; (2) Explore trial caption Displayed: unknown display... overlaps Marker area proportional to duration. Reproduce without private data using a 1024x768 screen, image frame (112,84,800,600), Display.Unknown, duration-weighted density map and fixation marks. Production MapRaster/TrialScene/TrialView used; no custom heatmap drawing. Density hotspot orientation and pixel colours pass exactly. Private evidence retained under fixtures/private/pcmri/runs/20261015-native-visuals; not to be committed or copied into public issue attachments. Check newer design slices before implementing. Acceptance: caption and legend layout remain readable at these sizes, with native renderer screenshot regression checks.
set.title: Trial map legend clips and Explore caption overlaps at normal pane sizes
